text.en: Asha's friend moved to a big city for her father's job. "Why do people move?" she asked.

Migration is the movement of people from one place to another to live. It may be internal, within a country, or international, between countries. It may be permanent or temporary and voluntary or forced.
Push factors drive people away, such as poverty, lack of jobs, drought or war. Pull factors attract them, such as jobs, better schools and safety. Rural to urban migration is common in India.
Migration brings remittances and skills but can cause crowded cities, slums and pressure on services. Migrant workers need protection and good living conditions.

text.en: This is the push and pull of migration.

requiredIdeas.en: It can be within a country too.
